name: LilyGO T-Dongle C5 I2C Scan (pinout verify)
description: Verifies the LilyGO T-Dongle C5 I2C port pinout by probing the bus on the JST/UART pins (SDA=GPIO11 / SCL=GPIO12). With an HTU31D attached, the device's Probed response should report found address 0x40 (64) (or 0x41/65 if ADDR is tied high). An empty addresses list means 'scan all'. Uses the migrate-api-v2 (api-v2-pins-as-strings) i2c proto shape.

steps.name: checkin-response
steps.description: Respond to device checkin with OK and board capabilities

steps.name: i2c-scan
steps.description: Probe the I2C bus on SDA=D11 / SCL=D12 (scan all addresses). Expect the HTU31D at 0x40 in the device's Probed reply.
